_comment: Groupwise ranking. The unit of data is a QUERY with its whole candidate list, so the micro batch below counts queries, not documents -- 32 queries x 12 documents = 384 documents per step. train_batch_size is deliberately OMITTED so DeepSpeed derives it and any --num_gpus works without editing this file.
_precision_comment: Both disabled ON PURPOSE. SetRank's attention over a 12-document set produces small logit differences, and ListNet's softmax cross-entropy over the list is the quantity being compared across architectures -- running one model in reduced precision and reading a 0.005 NDCG difference would be measuring the dtype. These models are a few thousand parameters; fp32 costs nothing here.
_zero_comment: Stage 0. The largest model here is ~68k parameters; sharding optimizer state across ranks would add communication to save kilobytes. The memory that actually matters is the O(list_len^2) activation of the groupwise scorers, which ZeRO does not touch.
